title: Hypnotized on a Movie Date!
description:
You matched with me, and I’m so excited to go for our date. I chose a really fun one too, a classic movie night at the cinema! We’re going to see an old black and white movie about a kinda crazy controlling girl.

I wouldn’t be anything like that, right? I’m really nice! I even brought special earbuds to help block out some of those big loud movie noises. I’m so excited to get close in a dark room, and if I talk the whole time it doesn’t matter does it? It’s only some old movie. It’s a date, it’s about getting to know each other, getting to hear my hypnotic, sweet voice. Getting to fall under my spell and feel yourself losing track of time.

A hypnotic date femdom hypno roleplay where you’re my lucky, lucky date and I hypnotize you while the movie plays, with subliminal layers, some memory play and some slightly possessive romantic yandere vibes. Part of the BLIND DATE collab from the Hypno Collective!

Uses scenes from Of Human Bondag e (1934).

Art by Celyn.
